workflows.title: Portfolio - Gateway Selftest Sibling
workflows.description: A minimal, REAL n8n sub-workflow the interaction-gateway invokes via Execute Workflow (in-process, no HTTP, no secret forwarding) to PROVE live sibling routing end-to-end. executeWorkflowTrigger (passthrough) -> a Code node that does a small genuine task (deterministic keyword urgency classification) and returns an acknowledgement to the caller as its last node's output. Wiring the real business siblings is the SAME executeWorkflowTrigger pattern, applied per-repo on each sibling's own toolchain.
integrations: n8n Execute Workflow Trigger (passthrough) — invoked in-process by interaction-gateway (YKT4FJmC8Xg2G9hs)
Deterministic keyword urgency classification (a small real task, not a no-op echo)
workflows.notes: v0.1.0 — the gateway's live-routing proof target. 3 nodes (sticky + executeWorkflowTrigger + code). Active (n8n 2.x requires a referenced sub-workflow to be published). Proven 2026-06-03: the gateway signed-routes intent 'gateway-selftest' to this sibling in-process (executed:true), passing the secret-stripped clean payload + traceId, and wraps the real result. The business siblings get the same executeWorkflowTrigger per-repo (deferred).

workflows.title: Portfolio - Interaction Gateway
workflows.description: Generic SIGNED-webhook edge for the n8n Workflow-as-Code portfolio. One authenticated POST entry point that VERIFIES (timing-safe HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp + '.' + rawBody, with a replay window) -> SIZE-LIMITS -> SECRET-STRIPS -> ROUTES a request by an allowlisted INTENT to sibling workflow(s), so each business workflow keeps its clean JSON contract and the gateway owns the production-edge controls. The four security functions are the single source of truth in scripts/lib/gateway-core.mjs; the n8n Code nodes MIRROR them inline, and scripts/test-gateway-workflow.mjs extracts the COMPILED Code-node bodies, runs the golden scenarios against them, AND differentially pins the four security gates (size/signature/strip/route -- verdicts, reasons, whole-body strip) to the .mjs, so the deployed security logic cannot silently drift from the audited core. Pipeline order is size-before-signature (reject an oversized body before spending crypto): enforceBodySize -> 413, verifySignature -> 401, stripSecrets (never forwarded/echoed/logged), resolveRoute (fixed intent -> allowlist; callers never name a URL -> SSRF-closed by construction) -> 422. Security CONFIG (secret, body cap, replay window, live-mode) comes from env/credential ONLY -- a webhook caller can neither loosen a cap nor force live routing. STUB-DEFAULT: v0.1.0 proves verify + size + strip + the ROUTING DECISION offline (the eval-plan Layer-2 scope). Live Execute-Workflow sibling EXECUTION (in-process, no secret over HTTP) is the opt-in next increment (requires each target to expose an executeWorkflowTrigger). Every routed call + the response carry a generated traceId. Deploys to n8n via the public REST API (no MCP).
integrations: n8n Webhook Trigger (POST /webhook/portfolio/interaction-gateway, responseMode=responseNode, rawBody enabled for exact-bytes HMAC; authentication=none at the n8n layer, authenticated by the in-workflow HMAC check)
n8n Manual Trigger (editor demo: builds a validly-signed request so a manual run shows a full accepted round-trip)
Security core mirrored from scripts/lib/gateway-core.mjs (verifySignature / enforceBodySize / stripSecrets / resolveRoute)

Sibling routing by allowlisted intent. v0.3.0: DYNAMIC live Execute-Workflow execution (resourceLocator workflowId from TARGET_WORKFLOW_IDS) IMPLEMENTED + PROVEN LIVE (in-process, no secret over HTTP) against TWO callable targets -- gateway-selftest-sibling AND the real product-feedback SUT (6Gc3wmri0tJre07B, executeWorkflowTrigger); non-callable intents stay decision-only
Redacted audit event (ids + counts + verdicts only; never the payload or any secret)
workflows.notes: v0.1.0 -- the portfolio's eighth project and first production EDGE/gateway. 12 nodes (2 triggers: signed webhook + manual demo; 1 sticky; 8 code: normalize/enforceBodySize/verifySignature/stripSecrets/resolveRoute/routeToSiblings/buildResponse/buildDemoRequest; 1 respondToWebhook). Gates green: verify:gateway (20/20 pure core) + verify:workflow (13 golden scenarios / 133 assertions incl. differential-vs-core, OFFLINE, runs the COMPILED jsCode) + verify:static + verify:json. Hard acceptance criteria asserted as REJECTED NEGATIVES: signature-reject (401) / oversized-body-reject (413) / secret-strip / non-allowlisted-intent-reject (422) / traceId-present. SSRF-closed by construction (intent->allowlist, never a caller URL). Security config is env-only (a webhook caller cannot loosen caps or force live mode). STUB-DEFAULT: v0.1.0 proves verify + size + strip + the routing DECISION offline; live Execute-Workflow sibling execution is the opt-in next increment (it requires each target sibling to expose an executeWorkflowTrigger -- none currently do; the ADR rejected HTTP-to-webhook routing to preserve the no-secret-over-HTTP property). DEPLOYED + LIVE-VERIFIED 2026-06-03 as n8n workflow YKT4FJmC8Xg2G9hs (active): verify:live passes -- valid signed request -> 200 + echoed traceId (gw-live-0001), tampered body -> 401 -- proving the deployed jsCode end-to-end (HMAC over the exact rawBody via text/plain, the secret read from the runner env). DEPLOY REQUIREMENTS (n8n external task-runner): the Code nodes load crypto via require('crypto'), so the runner needs NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto, and GATEWAY_SIGNING_SECRET must be set in the runner's env (where JS Code nodes execute) -- both added to docker-compose. LIVE TESTING CAUGHT WHAT OFFLINE COULD NOT: the first live run failed 'crypto is not defined' (the external runner sandbox exposes no crypto global; the offline harness had injected it) -- fixed by require('crypto') + the allow-builtin flag, with the harness updated to inject require so the differential still pins the deployed copy. verify:live (Test-GatewayLive.ps1) SKIPs honestly (exit 0, labeled) when n8n / the secret / the deployed webhook is absent. DEFERRED: live sibling routing + per-sibling executeWorkflowTrigger, fan-out live execution, thin Feishu/Slack/Teams inbound adapters onto this generic core, rate limiting (gateway/platform-delegated). Never touches the 5 existing workflow ids.
